description: Matched controlled actor conditions. Common non-hand affixes are paid; each alternative intrinsic package occupies both hands at the same provisional package cost. Prices seek package values, not production loot definitions.
counterfactual_notes: Baseline AP/SP50/150/300 are controlled common actor attributes, not claims about optimized progression builds.

Fixed paid hand-package cost is an intrinsic item-package comparison, not derived from old provisional affix prices. All shieldArmor variants are explicitly alternate package designs, not free extra affixes.
CommonBlock talent20/40 chance costs7/14 points conservatively;60 costs20. Remainingtalents buy the same damage for every package.
Kills do not cancel fixed-survival incoming tracks. Kill-before-death is not guaranteed post-kill survival.
